title: Tate & Liza
rules: Tate and Liza! Pick a partner. Roll 2d6. 8 or higher: you both give 3. Under 8: you both drink 4.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Under 8. You both drink 4. 8-12: 8 or higher! You both give 3.

title: Delibird
rules: Delibird used Present! Roll d6. 1-3: drink that many. 4-6: give that many.

title: Raikou
rules: Raikou appears! Roll d6. 3: catch it and give 5. Anything else: take a bomb shot.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: Zapped. Take a bomb shot. 3-3: Caught it! Give 5. 4-6: Zapped. Take a bomb shot.

title: Entei
rules: Entei appears! Roll d6. 3: catch it and give 5. Anything else: take a high-proof shot.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: Burned. Take a high-proof shot. 3-3: Caught it! Give 5. 4-6: Burned. Take a high-proof shot.

title: Suicune
rules: Suicune appears! Roll d6. 3: catch it and give 5. Anything else: shotgun a beer.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: Blitzed. Shotgun a beer. 3-3: Caught it! Give 5. 4-6: Blitzed. Shotgun a beer.

title: Kyogre
rules: Kyogre rises from the sea! Roll d6. 5-6: catch it; give 5. 1-4: soaked; shotgun a beer.
dice: 1d6 — 1-4: Soaked. Shotgun a beer. 5-6: Caught it! Give 5.

title: Groudon
rules: Groudon wakes! Roll d6. 4-6: catch it; give 4. 1-3: rocked; take a high-proof shot.
dice: 1d6 — 1-3: Rocked. Take a high-proof shot. 4-6: Caught it! Give 4.

title: Rayquaza
rules: Rayquaza descends! Roll d6. 6: catch it; give 6. 1-5: dropped; take a bomb shot.
dice: 1d6 — 1-5: Dropped. Take a bomb shot. 6-6: Caught it! Give 6.

title: Game Corner
rules: The Game Corner calls. Roll 2d6. 7: give 7. Anything else: drink 2.

title: Bug Catching Contest
rules: Bug Catching Contest! Roll d6: 1 Paras, 2 Metapod, 3 Beedrill, 4 Butterfree, 5 Pinsir, 6 Scyther.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Paras: awful. Drink 1. 2-2: Metapod: give 1. 3-3: Beedrill: drink 1, give 1. 4-4: Butterfree: give 2. 5-5: Pinsir: drink 2, give 1. 6-6: Scyther: give 3.

title: Safari Zone
rules: Safari Zone! Roll d6. 1-2: bait; give 1. 3-4: throw a rock, dick; drink 4. 5-6: ball; drink 2.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: Bait. Give 1. 3-4: Rock! Dick move. Drink 4. 5-6: Safari Ball. Drink 2.

title: Rattata
rules: Rattata used Tackle! Roll d6. 1: you fainted; finish your drink. 2-6: give 1.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: You fainted. Finish your drink. 2-6: Give 1.

title: Chansey
rules: Chansey appears! Roll d6. 1-3: she eludes you; drink 1. 4-6: caught; give 2.
dice: 1d6 — 1-3: She eludes you. Drink 1. 4-6: Caught her! Give 2.

title: Poké Ball
rules: Throw a Poké Ball! Roll d6. 1-3: caught; give 3. 4-6: it flees; drink 3.
dice: 1d6 — 1-3: Caught it! Give 3. 4-6: It flees. Drink 3.

title: Supersonic
rules: Tentacool used Supersonic! Roll d6. Even: drink 2. Odd: you snap out and give 2.

title: Missingno
rules: A wild Missingno glitched in! Roll d20. 1-5: the game breaks; everyone drinks 3. Higher: drink 2.
dice: 1d20 — 1-5: The game breaks. Everyone drinks 3. 6-20: Drink 2.

title: Tentacool
rules: Tentacool used Constrict! Drink 2 and hold your drink until you finish it.

title: Machoke
rules: Machoke used Submission! Do anything the group tells you now, or drink 4.

title: Marill
rules: Rain Dance! Perform a song and dance the group chooses, or drink 3.

title: Wartortle
rules: Wartortle used Skull Bash! Crush a beer can against your head to avoid 3 drinks, and give those 3 to one player.

title: Ursaring
rules: Ursaring woke up angry! Drink as many as the group decides, and apologize.

title: Clefairy
rules: Clefairy used Metronome! Close your eyes and point at a player. Whoever you touch drinks 3.

title: Razor Leaf
rules: Bellsprout used Razor Leaf! Shred someone with a callout. They drink 1 in shame.

title: Sudowoodo
rules: A wild Sudowoodo blocks the path! Reveal an embarrassing truth to avoid 2 drinks, and everyone else drinks.

title: Contest Hall
rules: Hoenn Contest Hall! Runway walk to a group-chosen song. Give 5 if you do it; drink 3 if you don't.

title: Spinda
rules: Spinda used Teeter Dance! Dance to a group-chosen song or drink 8.

title: Bicycle
rules: I want to ride my BICYCLE! Sing the line or drink 3. Anyone who joins in drinks 1.

title: Spoink
rules: Spoink's Psychic! Guess the fingers behind your back. Wrong: drink that many. Right: they do.

title: Electrode
rules: Electrode used Selfdestruct! Choose a player and you both finish your drinks.

title: Claydol
rules: Claydol used Double-Edge! Give as many drinks as you want, then drink half in recoil, rounded up.

title: Grimer
rules: Grimer used Sludge Bomb! Have every player combine their drinks in a glass, then finish it!

title: Pelipper
rules: Pelipper used Stockpile! Mix a splash of everyone's drink. Roll d6. Even: swallow it. Odd: choose who drinks it.
dice: 1d6 — 1-5: Spit Up! Choose who drinks it. 2-6: Swallow it.

title: Fiery Path
rules: Fiery Path! Take off an article of clothing. Drink 4 to stay hydrated.

title: Brawly
rules: Brawly wants a high five. They may hit as hard as they can. Drink for every high five.

title: Erika
rules: Erika's grass battle! Roll d6. 1-3: stun spore; drink 2. 4-6: mega drain; finish your drink.
dice: 1d6 — 1-3: Stun Spore. Drink 2. 4-6: Mega Drain. Finish your drink.

title: Sootopolis
rules: Sootopolis Gym! Roll d6. Even: chug a glass of water. Odd: chug your drink to completion.
dice: 1d6 — 1-5: Chug your drink to completion. 2-6: Chug a glass of water.

title: Lickitung
rules: Lickitung used Lick! Give 2 and keep your tongue out until your next turn.

title: Team Magma
rules: Team Magma recruited you! If you're on Team Magma, make a rule for the rest of the game. Otherwise, drink 7.

title: Team Aqua
rules: Team Aqua recruited you! If you're on Team Aqua, make a rule for the rest of the game. Otherwise, drink 7.

title: Pineco
rules: Pineco used Protect! Drink 2. Until your next turn, ignore every drink given to you.

title: Farfetch'd
rules: Farfetch'd got away! Drink 1. For the rest of the game, fetch drinks for anyone who asks.

title: Raticate
rules: Raticate used Pursuit! For the rest of the game, drink 1 whenever you leave the table.

title: Mankey
rules: Mankey used Swagger! Teach a handshake. Until your next turn, fumbles drink 1.

title: Aipom
rules: Aipom used Baton Pass! Until your next turn, pass every drink you're given to another player.

title: Skarmory
rules: Steel Wing! Drink 3. Until your next turn, drinks given to you bounce to the player on your right.

title: Tropius
rules: Tropius used Sweet Scent! Until your next turn, every drink given out comes to you instead.

title: Sandshrew
rules: Sandshrew used Sand-Attack! Drink with your non-dominant hand for the rest of the game.

title: Vulpix
rules: Vulpix used Will-O-Wisp! For the rest of the game, add 1 to every drink you take.

title: Shuppet
rules: Shuppet used Curse! For the rest of the game, drink 1 every time you curse.

title: Ditto
rules: Ditto used Transform! Until your next turn, copy everything the next player does.

title: Psyduck
rules: Psyduck has a headache! Until your next turn, hold your head. Let go and drink 1.

title: Lapras
rules: Lapras used Confuse Ray! Pick a player. Until your next turn, they speak in questions or drink 1.

title: Egg
rules: You got an Egg! Hold an object until your next turn. Caught without it: drink 1.

title: Togepi
rules: Togepi hatched! Make a new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

title: Eevee
rules: Eeveelution time! Choose a new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

title: Trick House
rules: The Trick House! Make a tricky new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

title: Pokémon Tower
rules: Out of respect for the dead: no talking until your next turn. Slip and drink 1.

title: Murkrow
rules: Murkrow used Mimic! Pick a player and repeat everything they say until your next turn.

title: Barboach
rules: Barboach used Mud-slap! Name a player. For the rest of the game, they may slap you once after a full drink.

title: Mawile
rules: Mawile used Vicegrip! Until your next turn, grab a player and squeeze them. Drink 4 and apologize.

title: Relicanth
rules: Relicanth used Dive! Kneel under the table until your next turn. Surface early: drink 2.

title: Norman
rules: Norman's gym! Call another player daddy for the rest of the game. Drink 4, or drink 8 to keep your dignity.
